name: glb-designer-stage11a
description: Asset Studio Stage 11a — per-point CURVED profiles in the GLB Asset Designer (Pro, glbDesigner on). Part 1: two lathe vases side by side seeded via __glbDesigner.setSpec — LEFT uses the smooth vase preset (belly points carry the [x, y, 1] smooth flag → Catmull-Rom); RIGHT uses the SAME points all-sharp ([x, y]) → a faceted polyline. Asserts the smooth part's spec profile carries a length-3 point while the sharp part's does not, then screenshots the 3D preview — the smooth vase must read as one continuous curve with no faceted kinks, the sharp one visibly polygonal. Part 2: select the sharp vase, open its ProfileEditor (all SQUARE markers, straight-ish preview), DOUBLE-CLICK an interior point's touch target to toggle it smooth (the documented double-tap gesture), assert the spec's profile[3] gained a third element AND a CIRCLE marker appeared, and screenshot the editor showing the mixed circle/square points + the curved preview path. Review the frames HARD — the curve quality is the deliverable.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: verify-flag-on
steps.failMessage: glbDesigner is a pro-tier flag → on in Pro mode by default

steps.name: seed-two-vases
steps.comment: LEFT: smooth vase (belly points flagged [x,y,1]). RIGHT: identical points all-sharp.
steps.eval: (function(){ const smooth = [[0,0],[0.42,0.02,1],[0.5,0.1,1],[0.86,0.34,1],[0.56,0.6,1],[0.36,0.8,1],[0.52,0.94,1],[0.44,1]]; const sharp = smooth.map(p => [p[0], p[1]]); const s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__glbDesigner.getSpec())); s.partGroups = []; s.combineGroups = []; s.parts = [ { id:'vase-smooth', kind:'lathe', name:'Smooth vase', position:[-0.32,0.25,0], size:[0.3,0.5,0.3], color:'#7a9bbf', roughness:0.4, metalness:0.05, segments:48, profile: smooth }, { id:'vase-sharp', kind:'lathe', name:'Sharp vase', position:[0.32,0.25,0], size:[0.3,0.5,0.3], color:'#bf8a6a', roughness:0.4, metalness:0.05, segments:48, profile: sharp } ]; window.__glbDesigner.setSpec(s); })()

steps.name: assert-smooth-flag-in-spec
steps.comment: The smooth vase's profile carries at least one length-3 (flagged) point; the sharp vase carries none — proof the representation round-trips through the spec.
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const sm = s.parts.find(p => p.id==='vase-smooth'); const sh = s.parts.find(p => p.id==='vase-sharp'); if (!sm || !sh) throw new Error('vase parts missing'); const smoothCount = sm.profile.filter(p => p.length === 3 && p[2]).length; if (smoothCount < 1) throw new Error('smooth vase should carry flagged points, got ' + smoothCount); const sharpFlagged = sh.profile.filter(p => p.length === 3).length; if (sharpFlagged !== 0) throw new Error('sharp vase must have no flagged points, got ' + sharpFlagged); console.log('STAGE11A_SPEC smoothFlagged=' + smoothCount + ' sharpFlagged=' + sharpFlagged); })()

steps.name: shot-smooth-vs-sharp
steps.comment: LEFT vase = continuous curve (no faceted kinks along the profile); RIGHT vase = visibly polygonal. Curve quality is the deliverable — review this frame.

steps.name: select-sharp-vase
steps.comment: Click the Sharp vase layer row → opens its PartInspector + ProfileEditor.
steps.eval: (function(){ const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-row')]; const row = rows.find(r => /sharp vase/i.test(r.textContent || '')); if (!row) throw new Error('Sharp vase layer row not found'); row.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-profile-editor
steps.failMessage: selecting the lathe should show the shared ProfileEditor

steps.name: assert-all-square-before
steps.comment: A fully-sharp profile → the editor draws only SQUARE (rect) markers, no smooth circles.
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.glb-designer svg[aria-label="Profile point editor"]'); const rects = svg.querySelectorAll('rect'); const markers = [...svg.querySelectorAll('circle')].filter(c => c.getAttribute('fill') !== 'transparent'); if (rects.length < 1) throw new Error('expected square markers for an all-sharp profile'); if (markers.length !== 0) throw new Error('an all-sharp profile should have no circle markers, got ' + markers.length); window.__sqBefore = rects.length; })()

steps.name: scroll-editor-into-view
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.glb-designer svg[aria-label="Profile point editor"]'); svg.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); })()

steps.name: toggle-point-smooth
steps.comment: Double-tap an interior point's transparent 44px touch target (index 3, a belly point) → onDoubleClick flips it smooth.
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.glb-designer svg[aria-label="Profile point editor"]'); const touch = [...svg.querySelectorAll('circle')].filter(c => c.getAttribute('fill') === 'transparent'); if (touch.length < 4) throw new Error('expected >=4 touch targets, got ' + touch.length); touch[3].dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: keep-editor-in-view
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.glb-designer svg[aria-label="Profile point editor"]'); svg.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); })()

steps.name: assert-point-now-smooth
steps.comment: The toggled point gained a third (flag) element in the live spec AND a circle marker rendered.
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const sh = s.parts.find(p => p.id==='vase-sharp'); if (!sh) throw new Error('sharp vase missing'); const p3 = sh.profile[3]; if (!(p3.length === 3 && p3[2])) throw new Error('profile[3] should be smooth after the toggle, got ' + JSON.stringify(p3)); const svg = document.querySelector('.glb-designer svg[aria-label="Profile point editor"]'); const markers = [...svg.querySelectorAll('circle')].filter(c => c.getAttribute('fill') !== 'transparent'); if (markers.length < 1) throw new Error('expected a circle marker for the newly-smooth point'); console.log('STAGE11A_TOGGLE profile3=' + JSON.stringify(p3) + ' circleMarkers=' + markers.length); })()

steps.name: shot-toggled-editor
steps.comment: The editor now shows a CIRCLE at the toggled point among the SQUARE corners, and the preview path curves through it.
